Approval Policy.description:
This Approval Policy Action is a multi-step serial approval where the first reviewer is the recipient’s manager and the second is the manager’s manager.

If both reviewers approve, the request is successfully approved. 

This step is set to Medium priority.
Reviewers are emailed daily reminders if they haven’t yet completed the request.
If this review is not completed within 8 days, the request expires and is rejected.

Compare Strings 1.description: The status of the Approval Policy Action is evaluated to determine if the request was approved. If the status is APPROVED, it evaluates to True. If it is any other status, it evaluates to False.

attributes.description: A request for {{$.trigger.requestedItem.name}}, with a recipient of {{$.getIdentity.displayName}} which is outside of the Security Department. A Certification Campaign of their access has been generated.
attributes.name: Non Security Access Granted

Create Certification Campaign.description: The access request was approved for an identity outside the Security department. A Certification Campaign is created and assigned to the recipient’s manager to certify all access. This is an example of an event-based certification.

End Step - Success.description:
The recipient is part of the Security department, therefore this access request is auto-approved. The workflow completed successfully.

When configuring for Auto-Approval or Auto-Rejection, the End Step determines the outcome since there is no approval activity. To auto-approve, add an "End Step - Success" where no prior Approval Policy Action exists.

End Step - Success 1.description: The access request was rejected, and the recipient was successfully notified. The workflow completed successfully.

End Step - Success 2.description: The access request was approved. A certification campaign was created, and the manager was notified. The workflow completed successfully.

Get Identity 1.description:
The full set of attributes for the recipient’s manager are retrieved. 
The recipient is not in the Security department, so a multi-level manager approval is required to approve this access.

attributes.body:
Hello {{$.getIdentity1.attributes.displayName}}, 

An out-of-band access request was approved for {{$.trigger.requestedItem.name}} and recipient {{$.trigger.requestedFor.name}}.

Due to this business exception, a certification campaign has been created and assigned to you with the certification name: {{$.createCertificationCampaign.name}}. Please review your direct report's access. 

Thank you, 

Your Security Team
attributes.subject: Exception Access for {{$.trigger.requestedFor.name}}

Send Email.description: An email is sent to the manager of the recipient to inform them that the request for access was approved, and a certification campaign was created.

attributes.body: Hello {{$.trigger.requestedFor.name}}, Your request for {{$.trigger.requestedItem.name}} has been approved.

Send Slack Message.description: The access request was approved. A Slack notification is sent to the recipient to notify them that their request was approved.

Send Slack Message 1.description: The access request was not approved. A Slack notification is sent to the recipient to notify them that their request was rejected.

object.description: This workflow is triggered when an access request is submitted. Based on the recipient’s attributes, the request is either auto-approved or is considered and exception and goes through a multi-step approval process. If approved as an exception, a certification campaign is created to ensure all access for the recipient is necessary. The recipient is notified of the review results via Slack.
